xmldoc.short_description: Open ZIP archive returned by nelson.io.zip.open.

description.p: nelson.io.ZipArchive keeps a ZIP archive open between calls.

Read-only properties: Source (file name, empty for an in-memory archive), Mode, Compression and Level (defaults of new entries), Encryption ("none", or the method used to encrypt the files written: "aes256", "aes128" or "zipcrypto") and IsOpen. Archives encrypted with AES-192 can still be read.
Methods: entries, read, readtext, write, add, tobytes, fopen and close, with the same arguments as the nelson.io.zip functions without the first one.
Displaying the object shows these properties. Deleting the object closes the archive.
